ns2:course.label: Fundamentals of Management
ns2:course.description: An introductory course for second year veterinary students that explores the aspects of managing people in a business setting. Compliance, motivation, engagement, persuading, developing, and retaining employees will be covered as well s cross generational issues in the work place. No graduate credit. 1 professional hour. Approved for S/U grading only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No graduate credit. 1 professional hour. Approved for S/U grading only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Second Year class standing. Restricted to VetMed - Urbana-Champaign.
